commit.message:
Formalize the literal package 52 quadratic source, bounds, ratio substitution and finalizer

Check all 60 source gates, 22 positive-domain residuals, 136 shifted
coefficient records and 71 active pairs over arbitrary coefficient ports.
Pin the original source JSON and reproduce the Lean output with an
independent standard-library coefficient expansion and SHA checks.

Prove the selective kernel has exact degree 7516 and leading coefficient
two, its product has degree below 7865, and every selected coefficient is
twice the corresponding literal source row. Establish sharp corrected
coefficient height 4BK, specializing to the published 2^1182955 bound
without squaring the transport port. Add generic convolution, half-base,
pre-decoding positivity/range and two-block central-binomial lemmas.

Formalize arbitrary-position low-mask decoding, including the actual
weight-zero input and excluded dummy weight 81. Prove sharp sparse-code
completeness bounds, source-zero code positivity, exact power-of-two
scales and explicit cofinal witness bounds. Instantiate the exact H
reparameterization against the existing Jones numerical ratio theorem.
Prove package 52's actual margin-first finalizer and derive its majorants
and separation from the concrete arithmetic identities.

Document these checked stages while keeping the assembled source adapter,
actual native-port calibration, closed replacement equation and internal
ZFC equivalence explicitly open. Preserve the existing certified baseline.

Validation: standard Lake umbrella build PASS (3709 jobs); refreshed
umbrella import and new component regression/axiom files PASS; completed
audits use only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. Source generator
reproduces the checked Lean file byte-for-byte; git diff --check passes.

+import Diophantine.Paper1982.Master2
+
+/-!
+# Sparse low-digit masks with arbitrary positions
+
+For powers of two `b ≤ B`, subtracting `(b-1) Σ B^j` from the all-ones
+`B`-ary mask allows exactly the low `b` digits at the selected positions.
+The selected support may contain zero; any omitted padding position is forced
+to have digit zero. These are ordinary natural-number coding theorems.
+-/
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.LowMaskCoding
+
+open Finset Jones1982
+open scoped BigOperators
+
+set_option maxRecDepth 10000
+
+def supportValue (B : ℕ) (S : Finset ℕ) : ℕ := ∑ j ∈ S, B ^ j
+
+def mask (B b len : ℕ) (S : Finset ℕ) : ℕ :=
+  B ^ len - 1 - (b-1) * supportValue B S
+
+def maskDigit (B b : ℕ) (S : Finset ℕ) (j : ℕ) : ℕ :=
+  if j ∈ S then B-b else B-1
+
+def maskList (B b len : ℕ) (S : Finset ℕ) : List ℕ :=
+  (List.range len).map (maskDigit B b S)
+
+def linearCode (B : ℕ) (S : Finset ℕ) (x : ℕ → ℕ) : ℕ :=
+  ∑ j ∈ S, x j * B ^ j
+
+def codeDigit (S : Finset ℕ) (x : ℕ → ℕ) (j : ℕ) : ℕ :=
+  if j ∈ S then x j else 0
+
+def codeList (len : ℕ) (S : Finset ℕ) (x : ℕ → ℕ) : List ℕ :=
+  (List.range len).map (codeDigit S x)
+
+private theorem sum_range_support {S : Finset ℕ} {len : ℕ}
+    (hS : S ⊆ range len) (f : ℕ → ℕ) :
+    (∑ j ∈ range len, if j ∈ S then f j else 0) = ∑ j ∈ S, f j := by
+  have hf : (range len).filter (fun j => j ∈ S) = S := by
+    ext j
+    simp only [mem_filter]
+    exact and_iff_right_of_imp (fun hj => hS hj)
+  rw [← Finset.sum_filter, hf]
+
+theorem maskList_length (B b len : ℕ) (S : Finset ℕ) :
+    (maskList B b len S).length = len := by simp [maskList]
+
+theorem maskList_getD (B b len : ℕ) (S : Finset ℕ) {j : ℕ} (hj : j < len) :
+    (maskList B b len S).getD j 0 = maskDigit B b S j := by
+  unfold maskList
+  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ (by simpa using hj)]
+  simp
+
+theorem maskList_lt {B b len : ℕ} {S : Finset ℕ} (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hB : 1 ≤ B)
+    {x : ℕ} (hx : x ∈ maskList B b len S) : x < B := by
+  obtain ⟨j, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
+  unfold maskDigit
+  split_ifs <;> omega
+
+/-- An additive identity establishes that both natural subtractions in the
+literal mask are exact. -/
+theorem ofDigits_maskList_add {B b len : ℕ} {S : Finset ℕ}
+    (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hbB : b ≤ B) (hS : S ⊆ range len) :
+    Nat.ofDigits B (maskList B b len S) + (b-1) * supportValue B S + 1 = B ^ len := by
+  have hB : 1 ≤ B := hb.trans hbB
+  have hgeom := geom_sum_mul_add (B-1) len
+  rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hB] at hgeom
+  have hsum : Nat.ofDigits B (maskList B b len S) + (b-1) * supportValue B S =
+      (∑ j ∈ range len, B ^ j) * (B-1) := by
+    unfold maskList supportValue
+    rw [ofDigits_map_range, ← sum_range_support hS (fun j => B ^ j),
+      Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_mul]
+    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+    intro j _
+    by_cases hj : j ∈ S
+    · simp only [maskDigit, if_pos hj]
+      have he : B-b+(b-1) = B-1 := by omega
+      calc
+        (B-b) * B ^ j + (b-1) * B ^ j = (B-b+(b-1)) * B ^ j := by ring
+        _ = B ^ j * (B-1) := by rw [he]; ring
+    · simp only [maskDigit, if_neg hj, mul_zero, add_zero]
+      ring
+  omega
+
+theorem ofDigits_maskList {B b len : ℕ} {S : Finset ℕ}
+    (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hbB : b ≤ B) (hS : S ⊆ range len) :
+    Nat.ofDigits B (maskList B b len S) = mask B b len S := by
+  have h := ofDigits_maskList_add hb hbB hS
+  unfold mask
+  omega
+
+theorem mask_int_eq {B b len : ℕ} {S : Finset ℕ}
+    (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hbB : b ≤ B) (hS : S ⊆ range len) :
+    (B : ℤ) ^ len - 1 - ((b : ℤ)-1) * supportValue B S = (mask B b len S : ℤ) := by
+  have h := congrArg (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℤ)) (ofDigits_maskList_add hb hbB hS)
+  rw [ofDigits_maskList hb hbB hS] at h
+  push_cast [Nat.cast_sub hb] at h
+  linarith
+
+theorem codeList_length (len : ℕ) (S : Finset ℕ) (x : ℕ → ℕ) :
+    (codeList len S x).length = len := by simp [codeList]
+
+theorem codeList_getD (len : ℕ) (S : Finset ℕ) (x : ℕ → ℕ) {j : ℕ} (hj : j < len) :
+    (codeList len S x).getD j 0 = codeDigit S x j := by
+  unfold codeList
+  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ (by simpa using hj)]
+  simp
+
+theorem ofDigits_codeList (B len : ℕ) (S : Finset ℕ) (hS : S ⊆ range len) (x : ℕ → ℕ) :
+    Nat.ofDigits B (codeList len S x) = linearCode B S x := by
+  unfold codeList linearCode
+  rw [ofDigits_map_range]
+  simp only [codeDigit, ite_mul, zero_mul]
+  exact sum_range_support hS (fun j => x j * B ^ j)
+
+theorem codeList_lt {B b len : ℕ} {S : Finset ℕ} {x : ℕ → ℕ}
+    (hb : 0 < b) (hbB : b ≤ B) (hx : ∀ j ∈ S, x j < b) :
+    ∀ d ∈ codeList len S x, d < B := by
+  intro d hd
+  obtain ⟨j, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hd
+  unfold codeDigit
+  split_ifs with hj
+  · exact (hx j hj).trans_le hbB
+  · omega
+
+theorem linearCode_lt {B b len : ℕ} {S : Finset ℕ} {x : ℕ → ℕ}
+    (hB : 1 < B) (hb : 0 < b) (hbB : b ≤ B) (hS : S ⊆ range len)
+    (hx : ∀ j ∈ S, x j < b) : linearCode B S x < B ^ len := by
+  rw [← ofDigits_codeList B len S hS x]
+  have h := Nat.ofDigits_lt_base_pow_length hB (codeList_lt hb hbB hx (len := len))
+  simpa only [codeList_length] using h
+
+/-- The selected coordinate is exactly its base-`B` digit. -/
+theorem linearCode_digit {B b len : ℕ} {S : Finset ℕ} {x : ℕ → ℕ}
+    (hB : 1 < B) (hb : 0 < b) (hbB : b ≤ B) (hS : S ⊆ range len)
+    (hx : ∀ j ∈ S, x j < b) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ∈ S) :
+    linearCode B S x / B ^ j % B = x j := by
+  rw [← ofDigits_codeList B len S hS x,
+    ofDigits_div_pow_mod (by omega) (codeList_lt hb hbB hx),
+    codeList_getD len S x (mem_range.mp (hS hj)), codeDigit, if_pos hj]
+
+theorem linearCode_injective_on_support {B b len : ℕ} {S : Finset ℕ} {x y : ℕ → ℕ}
+    (hB : 1 < B) (hb : 0 < b) (hbB : b ≤ B) (hS : S ⊆ range len)
+    (hx : ∀ j ∈ S, x j < b) (hy : ∀ j ∈ S, y j < b)
+    (hxy : linearCode B S x = linearCode B S y) : ∀ j ∈ S, x j = y j := by
+  intro j hj
+  rw [← linearCode_digit hB hb hbB hS hx hj, hxy]
+  exact linearCode_digit hB hb hbB hS hy hj
+
+/-- The low mask bounds selected digits by `b` and kills every unselected
+digit, including any omitted constant-padding position. -/
+theorem tau_mask_iff_digits {B b len k v g : ℕ} {S : Finset ℕ}
+    (hb : b = 2 ^ k) (hB : B = 2 ^ v) (hB1 : 1 < B) (hbB : b ≤ B)
+    (hS : S ⊆ range len) (hg : g < B ^ len) :
+    τ 2 g (mask B b len S) = 0 ↔
+      (∀ j ∈ S, (digitsPad B g len).getD j 0 < b) ∧
+      (∀ j < len, j ∉ S → (digitsPad B g len).getD j 0 = 0) := by
+  have hb1 : 1 ≤ b := by rw [hb]; exact Nat.one_le_two_pow
+  have hkv : k ≤ v := by
+    apply (Nat.pow_le_pow_iff_right (by norm_num : 1 < 2)).mp
+    rwa [← hb, ← hB]
+  have hsub : B-b = 2 ^ v - 2 ^ k := by rw [hB, hb]
+  have hones : B-1 = 2 ^ v - 1 := by rw [hB]
+  have hdigit : ∀ j < len, (digitsPad B g len).getD j 0 < 2 ^ v := by
+    intro j hj
+    rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ (by rw [digitsPad_length hB1 hg]; exact hj), ← hB]
+    exact digitsPad_lt hB1 (List.getElem_mem _)
+  have hblocks := tau_ofDigits_iff hB (n := len)
+    (fun x hx => digitsPad_lt hB1 hx)
+    (fun x hx => maskList_lt hb1 hB1.le hx)
+    (digitsPad_length hB1 hg) (maskList_length B b len S)
+  rw [ofDigits_digitsPad, ofDigits_maskList hb1 hbB hS] at hblocks
+  constructor
+  · intro h
+    have hlocal := hblocks.mp h
+    constructor
+    · intro j hj
+      have hjlen := mem_range.mp (hS hj)
+      have h := hlocal j hjlen
+      rw [maskList_getD B b len S hjlen, maskDigit, if_pos hj, τ_comm, hsub] at h
+      have hsmall := (lemma_2_7 hkv (hdigit j hjlen)).mpr h
+      rwa [← hb] at hsmall
+    · intro j hj hjS
+      have h := hlocal j hj
+      rw [maskList_getD B b len S hj, maskDigit, if_neg hjS, τ_comm, hones] at h
+      exact (lemma_2_7' (hdigit j hj)).mpr h
+  · rintro ⟨hsmall, hzero⟩
+    apply hblocks.mpr
+    intro j hj
+    rw [maskList_getD B b len S hj, maskDigit]
+    by_cases hjS : j ∈ S
+    · rw [if_pos hjS, τ_comm, hsub]
+      apply (lemma_2_7 hkv (hdigit j hj)).mp
+      rw [← hb]
+      exact hsmall j hjS
+    · rw [if_neg hjS, hzero j hj hjS]
+      exact τ_zero_left _
+
+/-- Reconstruction from an arbitrary selected support; no position is reserved
+or implicitly excluded, so position zero is allowed. -/
+theorem code_of_tau_mask {B b len k v g : ℕ} {S : Finset ℕ}
+    (hb : b = 2 ^ k) (hB : B = 2 ^ v) (hB1 : 1 < B) (hbB : b ≤ B)
+    (hS : S ⊆ range len) (hg : g < B ^ len) (ht : τ 2 g (mask B b len S) = 0) :
+    ∃ x : ℕ → ℕ, (∀ j ∈ S, x j < b) ∧ g = linearCode B S x := by
+  obtain ⟨hsmall, hzero⟩ := (tau_mask_iff_digits hb hB hB1 hbB hS hg).mp ht
+  let x : ℕ → ℕ := fun j => (digitsPad B g len).getD j 0
+  refine ⟨x, hsmall, ?_⟩
+  calc
+    g = Nat.ofDigits B (digitsPad B g len) := (ofDigits_digitsPad B g len).symm
+    _ = ∑ j ∈ range len, x j * B ^ j := by
+      rw [ofDigits_eq_sum_getD, digitsPad_length hB1 hg]
+    _ = linearCode B S x := by
+      unfold linearCode
+      symm
+      apply Finset.sum_subset hS
+      intro j hj hjS
+      simp only [x, hzero j (mem_range.mp hj) hjS, zero_mul]
+
+theorem tau_mask_of_code {B b len k v : ℕ} {S : Finset ℕ}
+    (hb : b = 2 ^ k) (hB : B = 2 ^ v) (hB1 : 1 < B) (hbB : b ≤ B)
+    (hS : S ⊆ range len) (x : ℕ → ℕ) (hx : ∀ j ∈ S, x j < b) :
+    τ 2 (linearCode B S x) (mask B b len S) = 0 ∧ linearCode B S x < B ^ len := by
+  have hb0 : 0 < b := by rw [hb]; positivity
+  have hkv : k ≤ v := by
+    apply (Nat.pow_le_pow_iff_right (by norm_num : 1 < 2)).mp
+    rwa [← hb, ← hB]
+  constructor
+  · have hblocks := tau_ofDigits_iff hB (n := len)
+      (codeList_lt hb0 hbB hx (len := len))
+      (fun z hz => maskList_lt hb0 hB1.le hz)
+      (codeList_length len S x) (maskList_length B b len S)
+    rw [ofDigits_codeList B len S hS x, ofDigits_maskList hb0 hbB hS] at hblocks
+    apply hblocks.mpr
+    intro j hj
+    rw [codeList_getD len S x hj, maskList_getD B b len S hj, codeDigit, maskDigit]
+    by_cases hjS : j ∈ S
+    · rw [if_pos hjS, if_pos hjS, τ_comm, hB, hb]
+      have hxb : x j < 2 ^ k := by rw [← hb]; exact hx j hjS
+      have hxB : x j < 2 ^ v := hxb.trans_le (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) hkv)
+      exact (lemma_2_7 hkv hxB).mp hxb
+    · rw [if_neg hjS, if_neg hjS]
+      exact τ_zero_left _
+  · exact linearCode_lt hB1 hb0 hbB hS hx
+
+theorem tau_mask_code_iff {B b len k v g : ℕ} {S : Finset ℕ}
+    (hb : b = 2 ^ k) (hB : B = 2 ^ v) (hB1 : 1 < B) (hbB : b ≤ B)
+    (hS : S ⊆ range len) :
+    (g < B ^ len ∧ τ 2 g (mask B b len S) = 0) ↔
+      ∃ x : ℕ → ℕ, (∀ j ∈ S, x j < b) ∧ g = linearCode B S x := by
+  constructor
+  · rintro ⟨hg, ht⟩
+    exact code_of_tau_mask hb hB hB1 hbB hS hg ht
+  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
+    obtain ⟨ht, hg⟩ := tau_mask_of_code hb hB hB1 hbB hS x hx
+    exact ⟨hg, ht⟩
+
+/-- The requested binary-disjointness iff, including the necessary range. -/
+theorem mask_code_iff {B b len k v g : ℕ} {S : Finset ℕ}
+    (hb : b = 2 ^ k) (hB : B = 2 ^ v) (hB1 : 1 < B) (hbB : b ≤ B)
+    (hS : S ⊆ range len) :
+    (g < B ^ len ∧ g &&& mask B b len S = 0) ↔
+      ∃ x : ℕ → ℕ, (∀ j ∈ S, x j < b) ∧ g = linearCode B S x := by
+  simpa only [τ_two_eq_zero_iff] using tau_mask_code_iff hb hB hB1 hbB hS (g := g)
+
+/-- Every excluded position below the mask length has digit zero. -/
+theorem excluded_digit_zero {B b len k v g j : ℕ} {S : Finset ℕ}
+    (hb : b = 2 ^ k) (hB : B = 2 ^ v) (hB1 : 1 < B) (hbB : b ≤ B)
+    (hS : S ⊆ range len) (hg : g < B ^ len)
+    (ht : g &&& mask B b len S = 0) (hj : j < len) (hjS : j ∉ S) :
+    g / B ^ j % B = 0 := by
+  have ht' := (τ_two_eq_zero_iff _ _).mpr ht
+  have hz := ((tau_mask_iff_digits hb hB hB1 hbB hS hg).mp ht').2 j hj hjS
+  have hd := ofDigits_div_pow_mod (by omega : 0 < B)
+    (fun x hx => digitsPad_lt hB1 hx) j (L := digitsPad B g len)
+  rw [ofDigits_digitsPad] at hd
+  exact hd.trans hz
+
+/-! ## Distinct finite weight arrays -/
+
+def positions {n : ℕ} (w : Fin n → ℕ) : Finset ℕ := univ.image w
+
+def indexedCode {n : ℕ} (B : ℕ) (w : Fin n → ℕ) (x : Fin n → ℕ) : ℕ :=
+  ∑ i, x i * B ^ w i
+
+def indexedMask {n : ℕ} (B b len : ℕ) (w : Fin n → ℕ) : ℕ :=
+  mask B b len (positions w)
+
+def coordinateAt {n : ℕ} (w : Fin n → ℕ) (x : Fin n → ℕ) (j : ℕ) : ℕ :=
+  ∑ i, if w i = j then x i else 0
+
+theorem positions_subset {n len : ℕ} {w : Fin n → ℕ} (hw : ∀ i, w i < len) :
+    positions w ⊆ range len := by
+  intro j hj
+  obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hj
+  exact mem_range.mpr (hw i)
+
+theorem position_mem {n : ℕ} (w : Fin n → ℕ) (i : Fin n) : w i ∈ positions w :=
+  mem_image.mpr ⟨i, mem_univ i, rfl⟩
+
+theorem linearCode_positions {n : ℕ} (B : ℕ) (w : Fin n → ℕ)
+    (hw : Function.Injective w) (x : ℕ → ℕ) :
+    linearCode B (positions w) x = ∑ i, x (w i) * B ^ w i := by
+  unfold linearCode positions
+  exact Finset.sum_image (fun i _ j _ h => hw h)
+
+theorem indexedMask_eq {n : ℕ} (B b len : ℕ) (w : Fin n → ℕ)
+    (hw : Function.Injective w) :
+    indexedMask B b len w = B ^ len - 1 - (b-1) * ∑ i, B ^ w i := by
+  unfold indexedMask mask supportValue positions
+  rw [Finset.sum_image (fun i _ j _ h => hw h)]
+
+theorem coordinateAt_weight {n : ℕ} (w : Fin n → ℕ) (hw : Function.Injective w)
+    (x : Fin n → ℕ) (i : Fin n) : coordinateAt w x (w i) = x i := by
+  unfold coordinateAt
+  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
+  · simp
+  · intro j _ hji
+    rw [if_neg (fun h => hji (hw h))]
+  · intro hi
+    exact (hi (mem_univ i)).elim
+
+theorem indexedCode_eq_linearCode {n : ℕ} (B : ℕ) (w : Fin n → ℕ)
+    (hw : Function.Injective w) (x : Fin n → ℕ) :
+    indexedCode B w x = linearCode B (positions w) (coordinateAt w x) := by
+  rw [linearCode_positions B w hw]
+  unfold indexedCode
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro i _
+  rw [coordinateAt_weight w hw x i]
+
+/-- Each coordinate, including one at weight zero, is read without carries. -/
+theorem indexedCode_digit {n B b len : ℕ} {w : Fin n → ℕ} {x : Fin n → ℕ}
+    (hw : Function.Injective w) (hwlen : ∀ i, w i < len) (hB : 1 < B)
+    (hb : 0 < b) (hbB : b ≤ B) (hx : ∀ i, x i < b) (i : Fin n) :
+    indexedCode B w x / B ^ w i % B = x i := by
+  have hat : ∀ j ∈ positions w, coordinateAt w x j < b := by
+    intro j hj
+    obtain ⟨l, _, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hj
+    rw [coordinateAt_weight w hw x l]
+    exact hx l
+  rw [indexedCode_eq_linearCode B w hw x,
+    linearCode_digit hB hb hbB (positions_subset hwlen) hat (position_mem w i),
+    coordinateAt_weight w hw x i]
+
+theorem indexedCode_injective {n B b len : ℕ} {w : Fin n → ℕ} {x y : Fin n → ℕ}
+    (hw : Function.Injective w) (hwlen : ∀ i, w i < len) (hB : 1 < B)
+    (hb : 0 < b) (hbB : b ≤ B) (hx : ∀ i, x i < b) (hy : ∀ i, y i < b)
+    (hxy : indexedCode B w x = indexedCode B w y) : x = y := by
+  funext i
+  rw [← indexedCode_digit hw hwlen hB hb hbB hx i, hxy,
+    indexedCode_digit hw hwlen hB hb hbB hy i]
+
+theorem indexedCode_zero_digit {n B b len : ℕ} {w : Fin n → ℕ} {x : Fin n → ℕ}
+    (hw : Function.Injective w) (hwlen : ∀ i, w i < len) (hB : 1 < B)
+    (hb : 0 < b) (hbB : b ≤ B) (hx : ∀ i, x i < b) (i : Fin n) (hi : w i = 0) :
+    indexedCode B w x % B = x i := by
+  simpa only [hi, pow_zero, Nat.div_one] using indexedCode_digit hw hwlen hB hb hbB hx i
+

+    (_ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hU : 0 < U) (hV : 0 < V)

+    nlinarith [mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hgap)

+/-! # Arithmetic separation supplied by the package-52 margin -/

+/-- The concrete ratio registers satisfy `P<A^2` unconditionally. -/
+theorem ratio_P_lt_A_sq {M U : ℤ} (hM : 0 < M) :
+    2 * M ^ 2 * U < (M * (U + 1)) ^ 2 := by
+  have h := mul_pos (sq_pos_of_pos hM)

+/-- The three later Pell registers give the unconditional bounds used in
+the margin-first separation argument. -/
+theorem pell_register_bounds {A C E H D F G I : ℤ}
+    (hA : 2 ≤ A) (hC : 1 ≤ C) (hE : 1 ≤ E) (hH : 1 ≤ H)
+    (hDeq : D = (A ^ 2 - 1) * C ^ 2 + 1)
+    (hFeq : F = (A ^ 2 - 1) * E ^ 2 + 1)
+    (hGeq : G = A + F * (C * D + 1 - A))
+    (hIeq : I = (G ^ 2 - 1) * H ^ 2 + 1) :
+    C ^ 2 < D ∧ A ^ 2 ≤ F ∧ A ^ 2 ≤ I := by
+  have hAm : 0 ≤ A ^ 2 - 1 := by nlinarith
+  have hCm : 0 ≤ C ^ 2 - 1 := by nlinarith
+  have hEm : 0 ≤ E ^ 2 - 1 := by nlinarith
+  have hHm : 0 ≤ H ^ 2 - 1 := by nlinarith
+  have hAD : A ^ 2 ≤ D := by rw [hDeq]; nlinarith [mul_nonneg hAm hCm]
+  have hCD : C ^ 2 < D := by
+    rw [hDeq]
+    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ A ^ 2 - 2 by nlinarith) (sq_nonneg C)]
+  have hAF : A ^ 2 ≤ F := by rw [hFeq]; nlinarith [mul_nonneg hAm hEm]
+  have hD0 : 0 ≤ D := (sq_nonneg A).trans hAD
+  have hF0 : 0 ≤ F := (sq_nonneg A).trans hAF
+  have hCDD : D ≤ C * D := by nlinarith [mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ C - 1 by omega) hD0]
+  have hAG : A ≤ G := by
+    have hca : 0 ≤ C * D + 1 - A := by nlinarith
+    rw [hGeq]
+    exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg hF0 hca)
+  have hGm : 0 ≤ G ^ 2 - 1 := by nlinarith
+  have hGI : G ^ 2 ≤ I := by rw [hIeq]; nlinarith [mul_nonneg hGm hHm]
+  have hAGsq : A ^ 2 ≤ G ^ 2 := by
+    have := mul_self_le_mul_self (show 0 ≤ A by omega) hAG
+    nlinarith
+  exact ⟨hCD, hAF, hAGsq.trans hGI⟩

+/-- The concrete positive `Q` is bounded by `3*C^2`, not necessarily by J. -/

+    (hD : C ^ 2 < D) (hF : A ^ 2 ≤ F) (hI : A ^ 2 ≤ I)

+/-! # Package 52's exact numerical ratio interface -/

+/-- The six remaining ratio witnesses; the new j may be zero. -/

+  phi : ℕ
+  i : ℕ
+  j : ℕ

+/-- Every non-j register is taken literally from the existing ratio interface. -/
+def base (v : NewVars) (R N b g cap : ℕ) : Nine.Vars := v.old R N b g cap 0
+
+def Hnew (v : NewVars) (R N b g cap : ℕ) : ℤ :=
+  let u := v.base R N b g cap
+  RatioReparameterization.newH u.B' u.C u.F v.j

+def Inew (v : NewVars) (R N b g cap : ℕ) : ℤ :=
+  let u := v.base R N b g cap

+  let u := v.base R N b g cap

+  let u := v.base R N b g cap

+    IsSquare (u.D * u.F * v.Inew R N b g cap) ∧ u.J ∣ u.Q ∧

+    (B - 1) * (∑ i ∈ range d, B ^ i) = B ^ d - 1 := by
+  induction d with
+  | zero => simp
+  | succ d ih =>

+  have hmain : 2 * (B ^ padding + g) ^ 2 * p.eval B < B ^ (D + 2 * W + 1) := by
+    calc
+      _ ≤ 100 * H * b ^ 2 * B ^ (D + 2 * W) := hprod
+      _ < B * B ^ (D + 2 * W) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hsmall (by positivity)
+      _ = _ := by rw [pow_succ]; ring

+  unfold highWord
+  constructor
+  · linarith

+
+end DiophantineConsistency.PolynomialRangeBounds

+import Mathlib.RingTheory.Coprime.Basic
+import Mathlib.Tactic
+import Diophantine.Paper1982.NineRatio

+/-! # Exact quotient elimination in package 52's ratio registers -/
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.RatioReparameterization
+
+def oldH (B C : ℤ) (j : ℕ) : ℤ := B + j * C
+
+def newH (B C F : ℤ) (j : ℕ) : ℤ := C + F * (B + j * C)
+
+/-- Executable forward index: both divisions are exact under the theorem below. -/
+def newIndex (B C F H : ℤ) : ℕ := (((H - C) / F - B) / C).toNat
+
+/-- Executable reverse index. -/
+def oldIndex (B C F : ℤ) (j : ℕ) : ℕ :=
+  (1 + ((F - 1) / C) * B + F * j).toNat
+
+theorem isCoprime_of_congruence {J F : ℤ} (hJF : J ∣ F - 1) : IsCoprime F J := by
+  simpa using IsCoprime.add_one_left_of_dvd hJF
+
+/-- The old combined divisibility separates exactly into the two conditions. -/
+theorem combined_dvd_iff {J F Q H C : ℤ} (hJF : J ∣ F - 1) :
+    J * F ∣ Q * F + J * (H - C) ↔ J ∣ Q ∧ F ∣ H - C := by
+  have hcop := isCoprime_of_congruence hJF
+  constructor
+  · intro h
+    have hJ : J ∣ Q * F + J * (H - C) :=
+      dvd_trans (show J ∣ J * F from ⟨F, rfl⟩) h
+    have hF : F ∣ Q * F + J * (H - C) :=
+      dvd_trans (show F ∣ J * F from ⟨J, by ring⟩) h

+      simpa using dvd_sub hJ (show J ∣ J * (H - C) from ⟨H - C, rfl⟩)
+    have hJHC : F ∣ J * (H - C) := by
+      simpa using dvd_sub hF (show F ∣ Q * F from ⟨Q, by ring⟩)

+    refine ⟨q + z, ?_⟩
+    rw [hq, hz]
+    ring

+theorem newIndex_correct {B C F J Q H : ℤ} {j : ℕ}

+    have hprod := mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ (j : ℤ) - 1 by omega) (le_of_lt hC)

+    nlinarith only [hH, hB, hprod]

+  have hFz : F * z = H - C := by
+    have h := Int.ediv_mul_cancel hFH

+    rw [hcast]

+  rw [← hznew]
+  nlinarith only [hFz]
+
+/-- The reverse index is positive and gives exactly the same H. -/
+theorem oldIndex_correct {B C F : ℤ} (hB : 0 < B) (hC : 0 < C)

+    1 ≤ oldIndex B C F j ∧ newH B C F j = oldH B C (oldIndex B C F j) := by

+    Int.ediv_nonneg (by omega) (le_of_lt hC)

+    J * F ∣ Q * F + J * (newH B C F j - C) := by

+  dsimp [newH]

+    (hB : 0 < B) (hBC : B < C) (hF : 0 < F)
+    (hJF : J ∣ F - 1) (hCF : C ∣ F - 1)
+    (hj : 1 ≤ j) (hH : H = oldH B C j) :
+    (J * F ∣ Q * F + J * (H - C)) ↔
+      J ∣ Q ∧ ∃ t : ℕ, H = newH B C F t := by
+  constructor
+  · intro hd
+    obtain ⟨hJQ, heq⟩ := newIndex_correct hB hBC hF hJF hCF hj hH hd
+    exact ⟨hJQ, newIndex B C F H, heq⟩

+      J * F ∣ Q * F + J * (oldH B C j - C)) ↔
+      J ∣ Q ∧ ∃ j : ℕ, P (newH B C F j) := by
+  constructor
+  · rintro ⟨j, hj, hp, hd⟩
+    obtain ⟨hJQ, heq⟩ := newIndex_correct hB hBC hF hJF hCF hj rfl hd

+/-!
+# Carry and packing interfaces for selective quadratic sources
+
+These statements use an arbitrary finite polynomial support span and arbitrary
+selected targets. They do not retain the former full-Sidon positions. Numerical
+range hypotheses remain explicit, including the bounds needed before any
+digit decoding. Full-polynomial evaluation is proved, without truncation.
+-/
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.SelectiveCarry
+
+open Polynomial Finset Jones1982
+open SidonPositions (PairIndex)
+open SelectiveQuadraticCoding MultiTargetCarry
+open scoped BigOperators
+
+/-- The complete selective quadratic product. -/
+noncomputable def rowProduct {m r : ℕ} (w : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ)
+    (s : Fin r → Finset (PairIndex m)) (a : Fin r → PairIndex m → ℤ)
+    (u : Fin (m + 1) → ℤ) (E : Fin r → ℕ) : ℤ[X] :=
+  encoded w u ^ 2 * combined w s a E
+
+theorem combined_degree_le {m r : ℕ} (w : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ)
+    (s : Fin r → Finset (PairIndex m)) (a : Fin r → PairIndex m → ℤ)
+    (E : Fin r → ℕ) (D : ℕ)
+    (hD : ∀ k p, p ∈ s k → E k - pairWeight w p ≤ D) :
+    (combined w s a E).natDegree ≤ D := by
+  classical
+  apply natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero.mpr
+  intro n hn
+  simp only [combined, complementary, finsetSum_coeff, coeff_monomial]
+  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
+  intro k _
+  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
+  intro p hp
+  have hd := hD k p hp
+  exact if_neg (by omega)
+
+/-- Every coefficient outside the actual product span is zero. -/
+theorem coeff_rowProduct_eq_zero {m r : ℕ} (w : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ)
+    (s : Fin r → Finset (PairIndex m)) (a : Fin r → PairIndex m → ℤ)
+    (u : Fin (m + 1) → ℤ) (E : Fin r → ℕ) (W D : ℕ)
+    (hw : ∀ i, w i ≤ W)
+    (hD : ∀ k p, p ∈ s k → E k - pairWeight w p ≤ D)
+    {n : ℕ} (hn : D + 2 * W < n) : (rowProduct w s a u E).coeff n = 0 := by
+  classical
+  rw [rowProduct, combined, Finset.mul_sum, finsetSum_coeff]
+  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
+  intro k _
+  rw [complementary, Finset.mul_sum]
+  simp only [finsetSum_coeff]
+  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
+  intro p hp
+  rw [encoded_square]
+  simp only [Finset.sum_mul, finsetSum_coeff, monomial_mul_monomial]
+  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
+  intro i _
+  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
+  intro j _
+  have hi := hw i
+  have hj := hw j
+  have hd := hD k p hp
+  rw [coeff_monomial, if_neg (by omega)]
+
+theorem rowProduct_degree_lt {m r : ℕ} (w : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ)
+    (s : Fin r → Finset (PairIndex m)) (a : Fin r → PairIndex m → ℤ)
+    (u : Fin (m + 1) → ℤ) (E : Fin r → ℕ) (W D : ℕ)
+    (hw : ∀ i, w i ≤ W)
+    (hD : ∀ k p, p ∈ s k → E k - pairWeight w p ≤ D) :
+    (rowProduct w s a u E).natDegree < D + 2 * W + 1 := by
+  have h : (rowProduct w s a u E).natDegree ≤ D + 2 * W := by
+    apply natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero.mpr
+    intro n hn
+    exact coeff_rowProduct_eq_zero w s a u E W D hw hD hn
+  omega
+
+/-- The digit word is the full polynomial value plus the geometric bias. -/
+theorem doubled_shifted_polynomial_cast (p : ℤ[X]) {t n : ℕ} (ht : 1 ≤ t)
+    (hd : p.natDegree < n) (hb : ∀ i < n, |p.coeff i| < 2 ^ (t - 1)) :
+    ((2 * shiftedValue t n p.coeff : ℕ) : ℤ) =
+      2 * p.eval (2 ^ t) + (2 ^ t : ℤ) * ∑ i ∈ range n, (2 ^ t : ℤ) ^ i := by
+  push_cast
+  rw [shiftedValue_cast t n p.coeff hb]
+  simp_rw [add_mul]
+  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← eval_eq_sum_range' hd]
+  have hpow : (2 : ℤ) ^ t = 2 * 2 ^ (t - 1) := by
+    rw [← pow_succ']
+    congr 1
+    omega
+  rw [hpow]
+  ring
+
+theorem shiftedValue_lt {t n : ℕ} (ht : 1 ≤ t) (h : ℕ → ℤ)
+    (hb : ∀ i < n, |h i| < 2 ^ (t - 1)) : shiftedValue t n h < (2 ^ t) ^ n := by
+  have hbase : 1 < 2 ^ t := by
+    have hp := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide : 1 ≤ 2) ht
+    norm_num at hp
+    omega
+  rw [shiftedValue]
+  have hd : ∀ x ∈ (List.range n).map (fun i => (h i + 2 ^ (t - 1)).toNat), x < 2 ^ t := by
+    intro x hx
+    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
+    have hi' := List.mem_range.mp hi
+    have hpos : 0 ≤ h i + 2 ^ (t - 1) := by
+      have := (abs_lt.mp (hb i hi')).1
+      linarith
+    rw [Int.toNat_lt hpos]
+    have hpow : (2 : ℤ) ^ t = 2 * 2 ^ (t - 1) := by
+      rw [← pow_succ']
+      congr 1
+      omega
+    push_cast
+    have := (abs_lt.mp (hb i hi')).2
+    linarith
+  simpa using Nat.ofDigits_lt_base_pow_length hbase hd
+
+theorem selectedMask_lt {t n : ℕ} (ht : 1 ≤ t) (positions : Finset ℕ) :
+    selectedMask t n positions < (2 ^ t) ^ n := by
+  have hbase : 1 < 2 ^ t := by
+    have hp := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide : 1 ≤ 2) ht
+    norm_num at hp
+    omega
+  rw [selectedMask]
+  apply (Nat.ofDigits_lt_base_pow_length hbase ?_).trans_le (by simp)
+  intro x hx
+  obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
+  have hhalf : 2 ^ (t - 1) ≤ 2 ^ t := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (by omega)
+  have hpos : 0 < 2 ^ (t - 1) := by positivity
+  split <;> omega
+
+/-- The literal high word and mask fit inside the article's `4 B^n` block. -/
+theorem doubled_blocks_lt {t n : ℕ} (ht : 1 ≤ t) (positions : Finset ℕ)
+    (h : ℕ → ℤ) (hb : ∀ i < n, |h i| < 2 ^ (t - 1)) :
+    2 * shiftedValue t n h < 4 * (2 ^ t) ^ n ∧
+      2 * selectedMask t n positions < 4 * (2 ^ t) ^ n := by
+  have hs := shiftedValue_lt ht h hb
+  have hm := selectedMask_lt (n := n) ht positions
+  have hp : 0 < (2 ^ t) ^ n := by positivity
+  omega
+
+/-- The selected targets recover each separate residual, without row cancellation. -/
+theorem tau_selected_rows_iff {r t n : ℕ} (ht : 1 ≤ t)
+    (p : ℤ[X]) (E : Fin r → ℕ) (values : Fin r → ℤ)
+    (hE : ∀ k, E k < n) (hc : ∀ k, p.coeff (E k) = 2 * values k)
+    (hb : ∀ i < n, |p.coeff i| < 2 ^ (t - 1)) :
+    τ 2 (2 * shiftedValue t n p.coeff)
+      (2 * selectedMask t n (univ.image E)) = 0 ↔ ∀ k, values k = 0 := by
+  rw [tau_doubled_selected_iff ht (univ.image E)
+    (fun i hi => by obtain ⟨k, _, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hi; exact hE k) p.coeff hb]
+  constructor
+  · intro h k
+    have hk := h (E k) (mem_image.mpr ⟨k, mem_univ _, rfl⟩)
+    rw [hc k] at hk
+    omega
+  · intro h i hi
+    obtain ⟨k, _, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hi
+    rw [hc k, h k, mul_zero]
+
+def packTwo (L a b : ℕ) : ℕ := a + b * L
+
+theorem packTwo_lt {L H a b : ℕ} (ha : a < L) (hb : b < H) : packTwo L a b < L * H := by
+  unfold packTwo
+  calc a + b * L < L + b * L := Nat.add_lt_add_right ha _
+    _ = (b + 1) * L := by ring
+    _ ≤ H * L := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hb
+    _ = L * H := by ring
+
+/-- Binary carry decomposition needs only the two low-digit bounds. -/
+theorem tau_packTwo_iff {ell a c : ℕ} (ha : a < 2 ^ ell) (hc : c < 2 ^ ell)
+    (b d : ℕ) :
+    τ 2 (packTwo (2 ^ ell) a b) (packTwo (2 ^ ell) c d) = 0 ↔
+      τ 2 a c = 0 ∧ τ 2 b d = 0 := by
+  exact (lemma_2_10 ha hc).symm
+
+/-- Range bounds are proved before applying central-binomial decoding. -/
+theorem central_blocks_iff {ell h a b c d : ℕ}
+    (ha : a < 2 ^ ell) (hc : c < 2 ^ ell) (hb : b < 2 ^ h) (hd : d < 2 ^ h) :
+    (2 ^ (ell + h)) ^ 2 ∣
+      (2 * centralCode (2 ^ (ell + h)) (packTwo (2 ^ ell) a b)
+        (packTwo (2 ^ ell) c d)).choose
+        (centralCode (2 ^ (ell + h)) (packTwo (2 ^ ell) a b)
+          (packTwo (2 ^ ell) c d)) ↔ τ 2 a c = 0 ∧ τ 2 b d = 0 := by
+  have hs : packTwo (2 ^ ell) a b < 2 ^ (ell + h) := by
+    rw [pow_add]
+    exact packTwo_lt ha hb
+  have ht : packTwo (2 ^ ell) c d < 2 ^ (ell + h) := by
+    rw [pow_add]
+    exact packTwo_lt hc hd
+  exact (lemma_2_16 hs ht rfl).symm.trans (tau_packTwo_iff ha hc b d)
+
+/-- Match the division-free rank polynomial used in package 52. -/
+theorem centralCode_factorization {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) (S T : ℕ) :
+    (centralCode N S T : ℤ) =
+      (N - 1 : ℤ) * (((S : ℤ) + T + 1) * N + T + 1) := by
+  have h1 : N ≤ N ^ 2 := by nlinarith
+  have h2 : 1 ≤ N ^ 2 := by nlinarith
+  rw [centralCode]
+  push_cast [Nat.cast_sub h1, Nat.cast_sub h2]
+  ring
+
+end DiophantineConsistency.SelectiveCarry

+import DiophantineConsistency.SelectiveCarry
+
+/-!
+# Coefficient magnitude bounds for selectively encoded quadratics
+
+The bound depends on the magnitude of one kernel coefficient and the square
+of the coordinate one-norm. It incurs no row-count factor and does not
+require unused pair sums to be distinct.
+-/
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.SelectiveCoefficientBounds
+
+open Polynomial Finset
+open SelectiveQuadraticCoding
+open scoped BigOperators
+
+/-- The same isolation/exclusion certificate also prevents kernel terms from
+colliding. Thus a coefficient bound is not multiplied by the number of rows. -/
+theorem kernel_exponents_injective {m r : ℕ} (w : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ)
+    (s : Fin r → Finset (SidonPositions.PairIndex m)) (E : Fin r → ℕ)
+    (hE : ∀ k p, p ∈ s k → pairWeight w p ≤ E k)
+    (hi : ∀ k p, p ∈ s k → Isolated w p)
+    (hx : ∀ k l, k ≠ l → ∀ p ∈ s k, ∀ i j,
+      w i + w j + (E k - pairWeight w p) ≠ E l)
+    {k l : Fin r} {p q : SidonPositions.PairIndex m} (hp : p ∈ s k) (hq : q ∈ s l)
+    (he : E k - pairWeight w p = E l - pairWeight w q) : k = l ∧ p = q := by
+  have hkl : k = l := by
+    by_contra hkl
+    have hno := hx k l hkl p hp q.val.1 q.val.2
+    have hqE := hE l q hq
+    apply hno
+    dsimp only [pairWeight] at *
+    omega
+  subst l
+  refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
+  have hpE := hE k p hp
+  have hqE := hE k q hq
+  have hweight : w q.val.1 + w q.val.2 = pairWeight w p := by
+    change pairWeight w q = pairWeight w p
+    omega
+  rcases (hi k p hp q.val.1 q.val.2).mp hweight with h | h
+  · exact Subtype.ext (Prod.ext h.1.symm h.2.symm)
+  · have hle : p.val.2 ≤ p.val.1 := by simpa only [h.1, h.2] using q.property
+    have hpq := le_antisymm p.property hle
+    exact Subtype.ext (Prod.ext (hpq.trans h.1.symm) (hpq.symm.trans h.2.symm))
+
+/-- An injectively placed kernel entry retains its exact coefficient. -/
+theorem coeff_combined_at_entry {m r : ℕ} (w : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ)
+    (s : Fin r → Finset (SidonPositions.PairIndex m))
+    (a : Fin r → SidonPositions.PairIndex m → ℤ) (E : Fin r → ℕ)
+    (hinj : ∀ k l p q, p ∈ s k → q ∈ s l →
+      E k - pairWeight w p = E l - pairWeight w q → k = l ∧ p = q)
+    (k : Fin r) (p : SidonPositions.PairIndex m) (hp : p ∈ s k) :
+    (combined w s a E).coeff (E k - pairWeight w p) = QuadraticCoding.correction p * a k p := by
+  classical
+  simp only [combined, complementary, finsetSum_coeff, coeff_monomial]
+  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single k]
+  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single p]
+    · simp
+    · intro q hq hqp
+      apply if_neg
+      intro hqE
+      exact hqp ((hinj k k q p hq hp hqE).2)
+    · exact fun h => False.elim (h hp)
+  · intro l _ hlk
+    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
+    intro q hq
+    apply if_neg
+    intro hqE
+    exact hlk ((hinj l k q p hq hp hqE).1)
+  · exact fun h => False.elim (h (mem_univ k))
+
+/-- Every kernel coefficient is either zero or one original weighted coefficient. -/
+theorem abs_coeff_combined_le {m r : ℕ} (w : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ)
+    (s : Fin r → Finset (SidonPositions.PairIndex m))
+    (a : Fin r → SidonPositions.PairIndex m → ℤ) (E : Fin r → ℕ)
+    (H : ℤ) (hH : 0 ≤ H)
+    (hc : ∀ k p, p ∈ s k → |QuadraticCoding.correction p * a k p| ≤ H)
+    (hinj : ∀ k l p q, p ∈ s k → q ∈ s l →
+      E k - pairWeight w p = E l - pairWeight w q → k = l ∧ p = q)
+    (n : ℕ) : |(combined w s a E).coeff n| ≤ H := by
+  classical
+  simp only [combined, complementary, finsetSum_coeff, coeff_monomial]
+  by_cases hex : ∃ k p, p ∈ s k ∧ E k - pairWeight w p = n
+  · obtain ⟨k, p, hp, he⟩ := hex
+    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single k]
+    · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single p]
+      · simpa [he] using hc k p hp
+      · intro q hq hqp
+        apply if_neg
+        intro hqE
+        exact hqp ((hinj k k q p hq hp (hqE.trans he.symm)).2)
+      · exact fun h => False.elim (h hp)
+    · intro l _ hlk
+      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
+      intro q hq
+      apply if_neg
+      intro hqE
+      exact hlk ((hinj l k q p hq hp (hqE.trans he.symm)).1)
+    · exact fun h => False.elim (h (mem_univ k))
+  · have hz : (∑ k, ∑ p ∈ s k,
+        if E k - pairWeight w p = n then QuadraticCoding.correction p * a k p else 0) = 0 := by
+      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
+      intro k _
+      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
+      intro p hp
+      apply if_neg
+      intro he
+      exact hex ⟨k, p, hp, he⟩
+    rw [hz, abs_zero]
+    exact hH
+
+theorem abs_coeff_monomial_mul_le (p : ℤ[X]) (H : ℤ) (hH : 0 ≤ H)
+    (hp : ∀ i, |p.coeff i| ≤ H) (e n : ℕ) (c : ℤ) :
+    |(monomial e c * p).coeff n| ≤ |c| * H := by
+  rw [← C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, mul_assoc, coeff_C_mul, coeff_X_pow_mul']
+  split_ifs with he
+  · rw [abs_mul]
+    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hp _) (abs_nonneg _)
+  · simp
+    positivity
+
+/-- A uniform bound on every coefficient of the product, including nontarget cells. -/
+theorem abs_coeff_square_mul_le {m : ℕ} (w : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ)
+    (u : Fin (m + 1) → ℤ) (p : ℤ[X]) (H : ℤ) (hH : 0 ≤ H)
+    (hp : ∀ i, |p.coeff i| ≤ H) (n : ℕ) :
+    |(encoded w u ^ 2 * p).coeff n| ≤ H * (∑ i, |u i|) ^ 2 := by
+  classical
+  rw [encoded_square]
+  simp only [Finset.sum_mul, finsetSum_coeff]
+  calc
+    |∑ i, ∑ j, (monomial (w i + w j) (u i * u j) * p).coeff n| ≤
+        ∑ i, |∑ j, (monomial (w i + w j) (u i * u j) * p).coeff n| :=
+      Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
+    _ ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, |(monomial (w i + w j) (u i * u j) * p).coeff n| := by
+      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
+      intro i _
+      exact Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
+    _ ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, |u i| * |u j| * H := by
+      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
+      intro i _
+      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
+      intro j _
+      simpa only [abs_mul] using abs_coeff_monomial_mul_le p H hH hp
+        (w i + w j) n (u i * u j)
+    _ = H * (∑ i, |u i|) ^ 2 := by
+      simp only [pow_two, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
+      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+      intro i _
+      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+      intro j _
+      ring
+
+/-- The concrete `M(1+sum inputs)^2` bound with a dummy coordinate equal to one. -/
+theorem abs_coeff_padded_square_mul_le {m : ℕ} (w : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ)
+    (u : Fin m → ℕ) (p : ℤ[X]) (H : ℤ) (hH : 0 ≤ H)
+    (hp : ∀ i, |p.coeff i| ≤ H) (n : ℕ) :
+    |(encoded w (Fin.cases 1 (fun i => (u i : ℤ))) ^ 2 * p).coeff n| ≤
+      H * (1 + ∑ i, (u i : ℤ)) ^ 2 := by
+  have h := abs_coeff_square_mul_le w (Fin.cases 1 (fun i => (u i : ℤ))) p H hH hp n
+  simpa only [Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.cases_zero, Fin.cases_succ,
+    abs_one, abs_of_nonneg (Int.natCast_nonneg _)] using h
+
+/-- The paper's scale `B=4096 H b^2` gives the strict half-base bound on all
+coefficients after decoding the 31 bounded input digits. -/
+theorem half_base_bound_31 (w : Fin 32 → ℕ) (u : Fin 31 → ℕ) (p : ℤ[X])
+    {H : ℤ} (hH : 0 < H) (hp : ∀ i, |p.coeff i| ≤ H)
+    {b t : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (ht : 1 ≤ t) (hu : ∀ i, u i < b)
+    (hbase : (2 : ℤ) ^ t = 4096 * H * (b : ℤ) ^ 2) (n : ℕ) :
+    |(encoded w (Fin.cases 1 (fun i => (u i : ℤ))) ^ 2 * p).coeff n| <
+      2 ^ (t - 1) := by
+  have hsum : (∑ i, (u i : ℤ)) ≤ 31 * (b : ℤ) := by
+    calc
+      (∑ i, (u i : ℤ)) ≤ ∑ _i : Fin 31, (b : ℤ) := by
+        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
+        intro i _
+        exact_mod_cast (hu i).le
+      _ = _ := by simp
+  have hbZ : 1 ≤ (b : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hb
+  have hs0 : 0 ≤ 1 + ∑ i, (u i : ℤ) :=
+    add_nonneg (by decide) (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => Int.natCast_nonneg (u i)))
+  have hs : 1 + (∑ i, (u i : ℤ)) ≤ 32 * (b : ℤ) := by omega
+  have hsq : (1 + ∑ i, (u i : ℤ)) ^ 2 ≤ (32 * (b : ℤ)) ^ 2 :=

+# Package 52's margin-first finalizer
+
+The checked arithmetic in
+[`MarginFinalizer.lean`](Lean/DiophantineConsistency/MarginFinalizer.lean)
+matches Section 5 of package 52's nine-variable proof. Put
+
+```
+Omega = J*m
+Theta = J*n+Q-Omega*(V0+V1)
+F9 = (Theta^2-Omega^2*(a0+64*a1))^2-256*Omega^4*a0*a1.
+```
+
+The theorem `exists_value_zero_iff` proves that a natural `n` with `F9=0`
+exists exactly when `a0` and `a1` are integer squares, `J` divides `Q`, and
+`m>0`. Its hypotheses are explicit:
+
+* nonnegative radicands and positive `V0,V1,J,Q`;
+* unconditional strict majorants `a0<V0^2` and `64*a1<V1^2`;
+* `Q<V1`;
+* the conditional bound `m>0 -> a0<64*a1`.
+
+The proof recovers `m>0` first. An integer inequality shows that a
+nonpositive `Omega` and positive `J*n+Q` place `Theta` strictly outside
+the sum of the two majorants, forcing the norm to be positive. This is
+an algebraic version of the report's real-root bound and assumes no
+integrality of the radicals. Only after recovering the margin does
+separation exclude the zero root sum. Rational reconstruction and the
+rational-square-root theorem then produce signed integer roots.
+
+Completeness chooses nonnegative integer roots and constructs
+`n=m*(V0+V1+r0+8*r1)-Q/J`. The bound `Q<V1` proves this is natural;
+`Q` may exceed `J`. The polynomial data use no division or root operation.
+
+[`MarginSeparation.lean`](Lean/DiophantineConsistency/MarginSeparation.lean)
+proves the concrete arithmetic bounds behind those hypotheses. In
+particular, the actual margin
+`(K^2-4*(C-K*Y)^2)*cap-8*g*K^2` forces `C>K`, already for `Y>=2`.
+The Pell-register identities give `P<A^2`, `D>C^2`, `F>=A^2`, and
+`I>=A^2`, hence `a0=(P^2-1)*K^2+1<D*F*I=a1` on that branch.
+The concrete `Q=3*W*C-2*(W^2-1)` is positive and below `3*C^2`,
+which is below the second majorant `k*(8*D^2-4*D-1)*G*H`.
+
+[`RatioMarginFinalizer.lean`](Lean/DiophantineConsistency/RatioMarginFinalizer.lean)
+combines these bounds with the checked second-majorant defect identity
+from `NearSquareFinalizer.lean`. Its `exists_value_zero_iff` assumes the
+displayed Pell-register identities and primitive positivity/range bounds,
+and derives all separation and majorant obligations. It retains precisely
+the package-52 four-condition result.

+# Literal package-52 source: checked stages
+
+The current size target is package 52's interior-regular nine-positive
+equation: 548 binary operations and exact degree 15,502,748. Its finite
+proposal audit is recorded in [PROPOSAL_REVIEW.md](PROPOSAL_REVIEW.md).
+The modules here formalize its actual algebraic stages, with explicit
+port bounds. They do not yet establish a new closed consistency equation
+or a derivation of the equivalence inside ZFC.
+
+## Literal source and exact coefficients
+
+[`NativeQuadraticParent.lean`](Lean/DiophantineConsistency/NativeQuadraticParent.lean)
+contains the source's 60 live arithmetic gates and 22 residuals on 31
+positive inputs. Its four coefficient ports are `beta,K0,MC,MF`, in that
+order. The copied [source JSON](data/native-quadratic52/source_system60.json)
+has SHA-256
+`ac2a67782d344d1e74fd93bc3f09fae0097eaed1829fd8194ae235ae84763e48`.
+The [generator](scripts/generate_native_quadratic_parent.py) independently
+expands the gate expressions and compares all coefficients with the pinned
+package-52 certificate. Lean checks the emitted identities over any
+commutative ring and every port value; the generator is not trusted for
+those identities.
+
+Replace each positive source input by `x_i+1`, with `x_i` natural. Pad
+coordinate zero with one, and move the guard residual to the last row.
+The resulting 136 quadratic records use 71 distinct unordered pairs.
+`rowValue_eq_shiftedRows` and `target_zeros_iff_source_zeros` prove exact
+equality with the literal source predicate. They retain all four ports
+uniformly; no native coefficient tuple is assumed correct by these theorems.
+
+## Selective positions and coefficient bounds
+
+The weights come from `SelectiveCertificate52`. The dummy weight is 81,
+the maximum weight is 174, and an actual input occupies weight zero.
+For row index `k` from 0 through 21, the target is `349*(k+1)`. The last
+target is 7,678. Unused unordered pairs may collide; all used pairs are
+isolated, including against the other rows' targets.
+
+[`NativeQuadraticPositions.lean`](Lean/DiophantineConsistency/NativeQuadraticPositions.lean)
+defines the complete kernel
+
+```
+E(X) = sum_(k,p in rowSupport(k))
+         correction(p)*a(k,p)*X^(349*(k+1)-weight(p)),
+correction(p) = 2 on diagonal pairs, 1 otherwise.
+```
+
+Its exact degree is 7,516 and its leading coefficient is 2. The product
+`C(X)^2*E(X)`, with `C` the padded sparse input, has degree below 7,865.
+Its coefficient at each target is twice the corresponding literal row.
+These are complete polynomial statements: no higher terms are discarded.
+
+[`NativeCoefficientBounds.lean`](Lean/DiophantineConsistency/NativeCoefficientBounds.lean)
+checks every literal coefficient recipe. If `B0>=2`, `K>=16*B0`, and
+
+```
+0 <= beta,MC < B0,   0 <= MF < 2*B0,   0 <= K0 < K,
+```
+
+every corrected coefficient has magnitude below `4*B0*K`. In particular,
+the published bounds `B0=2^590069`, `K=2^592884` give the exact height
+`H=2^1182955`. The proof keeps `K0` linear, avoiding a larger bound from
+squaring the transport port. This specialization is conditional on the
+four port bounds; proving them for the actual native tuple remains separate.
+
+`SelectiveCoefficientBounds` proves that distinct complementary exponents
+give kernel coefficient height at most `H`, without multiplying by the
+number of rows. Convolution then gives the bound
+`H*(1+sum_i x_i)^2` for every product coefficient. For 31 coordinates
+`x_i<b`, the power-of-two choice `B=4096*H*b^2` makes every product
+coefficient strictly smaller than `B/2` in absolute value.
+
+## Sparse decoding, ranges and final stages
+
+[`LowMaskCoding.lean`](Lean/DiophantineConsistency/LowMaskCoding.lean)
+proves that the low carry test encodes exactly the coordinates `x_i<b`.
+It forces every unlisted digit to zero. The regressions use the actual
+weight-zero input and show that digit 81 is zero before adding the dummy
+term `B^81`, after which it is one.
+
+`PolynomialRangeBounds` proves positivity and the full upper bound for
+the high word before any binary decoding:
+
+```
+Jhigh = 2*(B^81+g)^2*E(B) + B*sum_(i<7865) B^i,
+0 < Jhigh < 4*B^7865,
+```
+
+under the explicit coefficient, base and weak-cap assumptions
+`0<=g<4*b*B^174`. The exact leading coefficient 2 supplies positivity.
+`SelectiveCarry` proves the full shifted-polynomial identity, rowwise carry
+equivalence and the central-binomial contract for two packed blocks.
+The intended block sizes are `N0=B^175`, `N1=4*B^7865`, hence
+`N=4*B^8040`. Their assembly into a literal source equivalence is in progress.
+
+`NativeBaseBounds52` checks the weak soundness cap, stronger completeness
+cap, exact power-of-two scale and an explicit arbitrarily large bound
+`b=2^(lower+sum_i x_i+1)`. `NativeSparseBounds52` proves
+`code<b*B^174` under `x_i<b<=B`, and shows that a literal source zero has
+positive code: the all-zero shifted tuple makes the original fifth row 1.
+
+The [ratio substitution](RATIO_REPARAMETERIZATION.md) preserves the actual
+register `H` while eliminating the extra divisibility quotient. Its
+`NativeNineRatio52` wrapper now checks soundness and completeness against
+the existing Jones numerical ratio theorem with the actual register data.
+The [margin-first finalizer](MARGIN_FINALIZER.md) proves exactly the
+package-52 four-condition norm test, recovering positive margin before
+extracting integer square roots. These are checked separately from the
+source adapter.
+
+The remaining chain must connect the packed source, the new ratio variables
+and finalizer, prove cofinal witness bounds, and calibrate the four actual
+native coefficient ports to ZFC refutations. Only after that chain is closed
+can the 548-operation equation replace the current certified baseline.

+def require(ok, message):
+    if not ok:
+        raise ValueError(message)
+
+

+    out = dict(a)
+    for exponent, coefficient in b.items():
+        out[exponent] = out.get(exponent, 0) + sign * coefficient
+    return {e: c for e, c in out.items() if c}
+
+
+def poly_mul(a, b):
+    out = {}
+    for ea, ca in a.items():
+        for eb, cb in b.items():
+            exponent = tuple(x + y for x, y in zip(ea, eb))
+            out[exponent] = out.get(exponent, 0) + ca * cb
+    return {e: c for e, c in out.items() if c}
+
+
+def polynomial(text, names):
+    n = len(names)
+    def literal(k):
+        return {(0,) * n: k} if k else {}
+    def visit(t):
+        if isinstance(t, ast.Constant) and type(t.value) is int:
+            return literal(t.value)
+        if isinstance(t, ast.Name):
+            return {tuple(int(i == names.index(t.id)) for i in range(n)): 1}
+        if isinstance(t, ast.UnaryOp) and isinstance(t.op, ast.USub):
+            return {e: -c for e, c in visit(t.operand).items()}
+        if isinstance(t, ast.BinOp):
+            a = visit(t.left)

+                return out
+            b = visit(t.right)
+            if isinstance(t.op, ast.Add): return poly_add(a, b)
+            if isinstance(t.op, ast.Sub): return poly_add(a, b, -1)
+            if isinstance(t.op, ast.Mult): return poly_mul(a, b)
+        raise ValueError(ast.dump(t))
+    return visit(ast.parse(text, mode='eval').body)
+
+
+def lean_coefficient(text, ports):
+    def visit(t):
+        if isinstance(t, ast.Constant) and type(t.value) is int: return str(t.value)
+        if isinstance(t, ast.Name): return f'ports {ports.index(t.id)}'
+        if isinstance(t, ast.UnaryOp) and isinstance(t.op, ast.USub):
+            return f'(-{visit(t.operand)})'
+        if isinstance(t, ast.BinOp):
+            if isinstance(t.op, ast.Pow):
